tracking: ADR-0342 (lane E23): API-only by the lane brief (no screens); the process analytics dashboard is posted on #453 for the design builder

gaps.GET /v1/process-analytics/templates: per workflow template: instances started and ended by status, cycle time percentiles, rework rate and open instances in a window
gaps.GET /v1/process-analytics/stages: per workflow stage, ranked by total wait time (the bottleneck ranking): visits, duration percentiles, wait vs work, rework and open visits
gaps.GET /v1/process-analytics/heatmap: stage x period heatmap cells (visits, median duration, wait) for the stages with the most wait
gaps.GET /v1/process-analytics/throughput: per period: workflow instances started and ended by terminal status
gaps.POST /v1/process-analytics/refresh: runs one process analytics projection pass from the workflow history now (admin, audited)
